mostViewed.en: The Russian (borscht) bread comes out of the oven around 2pm but selling starts ~1:40. Fresh out, it's piping hot with a crisp shell — rich, buttery and incredibly fragrant, with a fluffy crumb. Glorious freshly-baked carbs 💓
mostViewed.zh: 羅宋兩點出爐，但其實1:40就差不多會先開始賣，我1:15到是排第六個，但其實排後面也沒關係，羅宋會一直出爐，只是每一輪中間要多等15分鐘而已 排在我前面的阿姨們一次都是買一盤兩盤（一盤10個）覺得如果都排了至少買兩個起跳吧 剛出爐的羅宋麵包熱熱燙燙的，外殼酥酥的，捏著吃非常油也非常香，奶油加好加滿的結果就是很好吃！！！麵包體也非常蓬鬆，熱呼呼的精緻澱粉萬歲💓💓💓 0:04 0:06 0:09 +2 

mostViewed.en: Snagged the very last miso-edamame sourdough loaf. Genuinely sour with every bite, with a bread aroma that lingers after you swallow. Pricey but worth it — a true sourdough institution.
mostViewed.zh: 週日下午大概三點到現場，沒有預定，撿到現場最後一顆的毛豆乾酪酸種 麵包本身真的非常酸種，一邊咬一邊就有酸味，吞下去以後嘴巴還是有很明顯的麵包香氣，蠻好吃的！！！不便宜但值得，不愧是酸種名店 

mostViewed.en: The turkey-and-mushroom omelette set (NT$400) comes with the omelette, hash browns, yogurt, your pick of five breads, a juice, and free-refill coffee or tea. A pretty, generous brunch — reportedly a favorite of TV host Dee Hsu.
mostViewed.zh: 火雞肉蘑菇蛋捲$400 包含蛋捲、薯絲煎餅、優格、麵包五選一、果汁一杯、咖啡或紅茶（可續杯） 算是漂亮豐盛的早午餐！似乎是小S愛店 0:13 0:09 +2 

mostViewed.en: Ordered a (very pricey) cake for a coworker's birthday. From service to packaging to the cake itself, everything was in a class of its own — even ten stainless-steel cutlery sets and a custom photo card.
mostViewed.zh: 同事生日訂了好貴的蛋糕，從服務、包裝到蛋糕本身都尊絕不凡，甚至附上的十套餐具是不鏽鋼🍴還有一張客製化照片的硬卡片.. （客製化印上去的東西要提前傳LINE給他們的官方Line） +3 

mostViewed.en: Lives up to the unanimous praise. Today I especially loved the mixed antipasti and the lasagna. About NT$2,200 for two (a starter, two mains, a dessert, a latte).
mostViewed.zh: 好吃！不愧一面倒的好評，今天特別喜歡綜合開胃菜和千層麵😍 💰兩個人吃一個前菜、兩個主食、一個甜點、一杯拿鐵，總共$2200左右 - 0:05 +4 

mostViewed.en: A well-known Shaanxi restaurant — delicious! Six of us ordered ten dishes for under NT$600 a head. For a Saturday dinner we booked about four days ahead and still nearly missed out on a table.
mostViewed.zh: 陝西菜名店，好吃！6個女生點了10道菜，分下來一個人不到600 這天是吃周六晚餐，提前4天左右訂位就快訂不到了，只能吃1730-1830這種很趕的時間，還好當天有客人往後時間，讓我們吃到更久 0:08 +8 

mostViewed.en: The Pad Thai is a must-order (add meat for +NT$60) — absolutely delicious. The hot-and-sour rice-noodle soup is great too.
mostViewed.zh: ‼️必點Pad Thai（可以加肉+$60）超級好吃 酸辣湯河粉也很不錯！ - +2 

mostViewed.en: Recommended by podcaster Ken (Bailingguo) as the best cream puff he's had — so plenty of Taiwanese visitors go now. We had the cream puff and the canelé, and both were excellent!
mostViewed.zh: 看百靈果的ken 說是他覺得最好吃的泡芙，也因為他的介紹好像很多台灣遊客去吃XD當天去有3組台灣人左右 點了泡芙跟可麗露～都讚！以下分享！ 0:05 0:06 +3 

mostViewed.en: Said to be a Jensen Huang favorite — always packed, you'll share tables at peak hours. Must-order: the scallion pancake and radish cake. The pancake is hand-rolled to order, so worth the wait.
mostViewed.zh: 好像是黃仁勳愛店，人非常多，用餐時間要併桌 😍必須點：蔥油餅、蘿蔔糕 蔥油餅是所有餐點裡面等最久的一個，等到一度有點不耐煩，但是好像每一桌點的都等很久，出去才看到是廚房現桿的 +4 

mostViewed.en: A classic pickled-cabbage-and-pork hotpot institution. The sour-cabbage broth is the most sour I've ever had — your throat tightens from the punch. A must for sour-lovers; everyone else should wait through a few rounds of added broth.
mostViewed.zh: 酸菜白肉鍋老店～～ 酸白鍋湯底超級酸，人生吃過最酸的酸白鍋，感覺有加一堆醋，喝了喉嚨會有點緊緊的、受到衝擊的那種，愛吃酸的人務必來，一般人可以等加湯三輪再喝XD 大鍋的酸菜量真的很大 0:03 

mostReacted.en: Recommended by podcaster Ken (Bailingguo) as the best cream puff he's had — so plenty of Taiwanese visitors go now. We had the cream puff and the canelé, and both were excellent!
mostReacted.zh: 看百靈果的ken 說是他覺得最好吃的泡芙，也因為他的介紹好像很多台灣遊客去吃XD當天去有3組台灣人左右 點了泡芙跟可麗露～都讚！以下分享！ 0:05 0:06 +3 
mostReacted.why: Names exactly what to order — the cream puff and the canelé — at a spot Taiwanese travelers were already buzzing about.

mostReacted.en: There wasn't much information online, so here's my own little guide to visiting.
mostReacted.zh: 我是台灣遊客🇹🇼2026.1月份到訪 網路上的說明不多所以來介紹一下 0:05 +8 
mostReacted.why: There were almost no guides online, so she wrote the one visitors were missing.

mostReacted.en: A huge range of different milks — I drank three bottles and every one was genuinely distinct! Tip: the ranking board is on the station wall to the left of the shop, not the tags at the entrance. The glass bottles are deposit-return — finish at the door and put them back.
mostReacted.zh: 我是台灣遊客，2025.01月到訪 有巨量不同種類的牛奶，喝了三罐真的都很不一樣！看到大家說跟著排行榜點，喝了兩瓶才看到➡️排行榜貼在店的左邊的車站牆上，不是指門口掛著的店家推薦標籤 🥛這邊玻璃瓶都要還，站在門口喝完就把瓶子放回櫃檯上，有一些特別標可以帶走的 就是塑膠瓶，可以帶著慢慢喝 +2 
mostReacted.why: Insider mechanics most people miss — where the real ranking board is, and how the bottle-deposit system works.

mostReacted.en: Get there before the beef sandwiches sell out — at 2:30pm the most famous ones were gone and the rest felt ordinary. I came back at 11am, queued 30 minutes for the beef sandwich, and it was excellent.
mostReacted.zh: 我是台灣遊客🇹🇼2026.2月份到訪 ⏰務必在牛肉包賣完前來，第一天兩點半去 最有名的都賣完了，點了其他的都覺得普通 不值得，但隔天11:00 排隊排了半個小時來吃牛肉包，真的很不錯 0:04 +4 
mostReacted.why: Saves a wasted trip: the exact time to arrive before the famous beef sandwich sells out.

mostReacted.en: A Kyoto-ramen hyakumeiten (top-100 shop) that turns up in every search, and a Michelin Bib Gourmand pick. There are branches near the main shop and in Uji — all with queues.
mostReacted.zh: 我是台灣遊客🇹🇼2026.5月到訪 上網打京都拉麵一定會有的拉麵百名店，同時也是米其林餐盤推薦 🏬本店附近有分店、宇治也有一間分店，但都要排隊 +7 
mostReacted.why: Reassures it’s worth the queue — a Michelin Bib, top-100 ramen — and flags where the branches are.

mostReacted.en: The only overseas branch of the famous Milan pizzeria. Food critics rave about it, so I came to try it myself — genuinely good 🍕.
mostReacted.zh: 我是台灣遊客，2025.01月份到訪 米蘭知名披薩店的唯一海外分店，看各大美食評論家都說很好吃，就自己來吃吃看，真的不錯可以來吃🍕！ +5 
mostReacted.why: Settles the question — the famous Milan pizzeria’s only overseas branch genuinely lives up to the hype.

mostReacted.en: Cannabis cookies, ฿450 for three. A friend's recommendation — lots of Westerners and tourists. The staff member who walked us through everything spoke the best English I met on my entire Bangkok trip, and was happy to answer anything.
mostReacted.zh: 大麻餅乾450泰銖，三片入 朋友推薦的大麻店，洋人很多、觀光客也多，會有英文很好的店員（堪稱整趟曼谷旅遊，遇到英文最好的人）用心介紹，有問題都可以問 0:03 +2 
mostReacted.why: A candid, practical take on a curiosity-driven spot — the price, what you get, and that the staff actually speak great English.

mostReacted.en: A spot lots of YouTubers recommend. We arrived ~10 minutes after opening and it was already 80% full but with no queue yet — mostly Japanese diners, and locals were lining up by the time we left. It's tucked in a residential-looking area about a 5-minute walk from the Akihabara bustle.
mostReacted.zh: 我是台灣遊客，2025.01月到訪 很多YouTuber推這間，我們在開店後大概10分鐘內到，店內已經8成滿了，還不用排隊 裡面很多日本人在吃，吃完出來甚至有看到日本人排隊，餐廳在一個很像民宅的地方，離秋葉原鬧區走大概5分鐘 
mostReacted.why: The one tip that matters: arrive right at opening to beat the queue at this locals’ favorite — plus how to find the hidden entrance.

mostReacted.en: The Russian (borscht) bread comes out of the oven around 2pm but selling starts ~1:40. Fresh out, it's piping hot with a crisp shell — rich, buttery and incredibly fragrant, with a fluffy crumb. Glorious freshly-baked carbs 💓
mostReacted.zh: 羅宋兩點出爐，但其實1:40就差不多會先開始賣，我1:15到是排第六個，但其實排後面也沒關係，羅宋會一直出爐，只是每一輪中間要多等15分鐘而已 排在我前面的阿姨們一次都是買一盤兩盤（一盤10個）覺得如果都排了至少買兩個起跳吧 剛出爐的羅宋麵包熱熱燙燙的，外殼酥酥的，捏著吃非常油也非常香，奶油加好加滿的結果就是很好吃！！！麵包體也非常蓬鬆，熱呼呼的精緻澱粉萬歲💓💓💓 0:04 0:06 0:09 +2 
mostReacted.why: Exact timing intel for a queue-heavy bakery — when the Russian bread comes out, and that it keeps coming so latecomers still get some.

mostReacted.en: Honestly, just okay — there are far better gelato spots in Italy than this famous one.
mostReacted.zh: 我是台灣遊客🇹🇼2026.2月份到訪 ㄨㄛˇㄐㄩㄝˊㄉㄜ˙ㄏㄞˊㄏㄠˇ ㄧˋㄉㄚˋㄌㄧˋㄅㄧˇㄓㄜˋㄍㄜ˙ㄏㄠˇㄔˉㄉㄜ˙ㄉㄧㄢˋㄊㄞˋㄉㄨㄛˉㄌㄜ˙ 
mostReacted.why: A rare honest “it’s overhyped” verdict on a famous tourist gelateria — people value the contrarian heads-up.

ownerReplies.en: Had the vanilla crème and a citrus flavor — the crème was the better of the two, with visible vanilla seeds.
ownerReplies.zh: 我是台灣遊客🇹🇼2026.2月份到訪 吃了香草Creme和某個柑橘類的口味 Creme比較好吃，裡面看得到香草籽 
ownerReplies.reply: Hi Winnie, I remember you. We're so happy you liked it. It's not easy to please a discerning palate like yours 🫶🏻 …

ownerReplies.en: Excellent and worth it — NT$2,000 for two, better than the other Venice restaurants I tried. We had the squid ink risotto and the zucchini-and-shrimp tagliatelle, both superb.
ownerReplies.zh: 我是台灣遊客🇹🇼2026.2月份到訪 非常好吃，值得一吃，兩個人吃2000台幣，但比我吃的其他威尼斯餐廳都還好吃 點了一個墨魚燉飯，一個櫛瓜鮮蝦細扁麵，兩個都很棒… 
ownerReplies.reply: Dear Winnie Hung, thank you for your warm and detailed feedback. We were delighted to learn that you enjoyed our squid ink risotto and zucchini and shrimp tagliatelle at Dallo Zio and that you thought they were worth recommending. It was

ownerReplies.en: A leather shop run by a lovely husband-and-wife — everything handmade by their family, and it is all so charming! Backpacks and shoulder bags of every size, wallets, cardholders, book covers, charms, keyrings, belts, even golf bags. Go browse!
ownerReplies.zh: 我是台灣遊客🇹🇼2026.2月份到訪 一對夫妻開在很附近的皮件店，商品都是他們家族手作的，超級可愛！！！！！來逛！ 🛍️不管是大小後背側背包包、錢包、名片夾、書套、小吊飾、鑰匙盤、皮帶、高爾夫球袋 通通都有 
ownerReplies.reply: Ciao Winnie, you understood our shop exactly for what it is. Yes, we are a small family leather workshop in Florence, and most of what you

ownerReplies.en: The quintessential Taipei brunch spot — big windows, roomy comfy seats, and a generous plate of bacon, sausage, egg and toast. Reserve at least a day ahead for the brunch slot.
ownerReplies.zh: 想到台北早午餐最typical會想到的店 大落地窗、寬敞舒服的座位、大餐盤裡面有培根、香腸、蛋、吐司，食物味道不錯又可以坐著聊天，一個人發呆也很開心，非常適合週末早上的一間店！儘量提前至少一天訂位才吃得到早午餐時段 0:04 
ownerReplies.reply: Thank you for your thoughtful and warm sharing 🥹💛 From the ambiance and menu to the little details you noticed, we could tell you truly "enjoyed your meal with care." We were so happy to have you relax and unwind with a familiar taste on

ownerReplies.en: Booked the lunch set on Tabelog — ¥16,500 for two. Everything was delicious, though the meat portion runs a little small (as Tabelog also notes).
ownerReplies.zh: 我是台灣遊客、2026.1月份到訪 我是在Tabelog上面預訂中午套餐的，兩個人16500日圓（一個人大約1650台幣） 所有東西都很好吃，不過肉的份量偏少（Tabelog上也有寫） 0:06 +10 
ownerReplies.reply: Thank you so much for your patronage and your warm and thoughtful review. We are delighted to know that you traveled all the way from Taiwan and enjoyed

ownerReplies.en: A trendy, much-hyped spot that genuinely delivers. It opens at 11:00 — if you don't want to wait too long, get in line before 10:45.
ownerReplies.zh: 我是台灣遊客，2025.01月到訪 熱門網紅店、實際上味道也不錯，11:00開門，不想等太久的話務必10:45前就去排隊，當天10:45前面已經有三個人了，店內位子沒有到非常多，大概前20個有機會第一輪 0:29 +4 
ownerReplies.reply: Dear Customer, thank you so much for taking the time out of your busy schedule to write such a detailed review. We are honored to have provided you with a wonderful dining experience.
